top_concerns: Theorem 1 is ill-posed and its proof a sketch; exact MI equality is degenerate for deterministic continuous layers, and the re-trainability claim is never tested
MI is replaced by a noisy MLP-loss-difference proxy (under-trained MLPs, 5 repeats), so masks are likely dominated by optimisation noise
No computational cost reported despite sequential per-node MLP re-training

Baselines are dated or unfairly adapted (unstructured GraSP/SynFlow, ThiNet with uniform ratio); ImageNet compared only to ThiNet with no FLOPs or published SOTA numbers; no ablation separating layer-wise allocation from the MI criterion
Evidence is plots only with no seeds or CIs and mixed wins/losses despite SOTA claims; CNN filters collapsed to one scalar undermines the MI-preservation claim
